subject: SIG package & upload instructions for FinTechCo procurement
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG & evidence request for vendor review

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement review for Redwood Inference (FinTechCo opportunity), our security team asked for a completed SIG questionnaire plus supporting evidence and the most recent SOC 2 letter. Can you provide:

- Completed SIG (XLS or PDF) with answers visible
- Evidence artifacts mapped to SIG controls (architecture diagram, screenshots, config extracts)
- SOC 2 Type II letter (2024/2025)
- Any attestation or third-party scan reports you can attach

Preferably we receive a single package (PDF bundle or ZIP) and an upload to our ProcurePortal by 2026-03-12. If you need a different portal or an alternate delivery method, let me know.

Also share a single contact for follow-up questions during the review.

Appreciate it — we aim to complete vendor review the week of 3/15.

Regards,
Lena Park
Procurement, FinTechCo

Attachment: SIG_Request_FinTechCo.pdf (1 page stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena@fintechco.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG & evidence request for vendor review

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear ask. I've looped in Sergio and Rishi from our GRC and Sales Ops teams and we'll own packaging this up. High-level plan: 

1) Produce a single flattened PDF (Redwood_SIG_20260308.pdf) that contains the completed SIG and a one-page cover letter.
2) Prepare an evidence matrix (evidence_matrix_20260308.xlsx) mapping artifacts to SIG controls.
3) Include SOC2-letter-2025.pdf and architecture_diagram_v3.pdf.
4) Collect screenshots/extracts (KMS, audit logs) as separate files and reference them in the matrix.
5) Create a ZIP bundle (password protected) and upload to your ProcurePortal. We'll send the portal upload record ID and a secure note with the ZIP password.

Couple of asks for you: please confirm ProcurePortal record ID format (so we can reference it correctly) and whether you need PDFs flattened (e.g., no comments or embedded form fields).

Target ETA: initial upload by end of day 2026-03-08 PST, final follow-ups by 3/10. If anything changes, we'll update you.

Contact for follow-ups: marissa_cole@redwood.ai (me).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_SIG_Summary.docx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: SIG packaging checklist / who owns what (internal)

Sergio / Rishi — forwarding Lena's ask. Below is a minimal checklist and assignment so we can meet the portal upload ETA. Reply with confirmations.

Checklist (deliverables & owner):
- Completed SIG (flattened PDF) => Sergio (Redwood_SIG_20260308.pdf)
- Evidence matrix mapping controls => Rishi (evidence_matrix_20260308.xlsx)
- SOC2 letter (signed PDF) => Sergio (SOC2-letter-2025.pdf)
- Architecture diagram (public version, no internal IP) => Rishi (architecture_diagram_v3.pdf)
- KMS screenshot & audit log excerpt => Sergio (kms_screenshot.png)
- Cover letter (one page) => Marissa (included in flattened PDF)

Packaging rules:
- Flatten all PDFs and remove comments/annotations; redact any customer PII if present.
- Use filename prefix FinTechCo_20260308_*. Do NOT include any internal ticket numbers in the public filenames.
- Produce a 1-sheet evidence index (tab 1 = mapping, tab 2 = file list & short descriptions).
- Create password-protected ZIP for upload; provide password via HubSpot secure note (do not email password).

Upload target: ProcurePortal (portal URL in Lena's message). Share the upload record ID and portal link in the thread once complete.

I can own the portal upload if you'd prefer, but I'd rather Sergio handle the final PDF exports since he has the SOC2 assets.

Thanks — let me know if you run into missing artifacts.

— Marissa

Quoted: "As part of our procurement review... prefer a single package (PDF bundle or ZIP) and an upload to our ProcurePortal by 2026-03-12."

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG packaging checklist / upload complete (procurement)

Marissa — confirmed. I assembled the files, flattened the SIG PDF, and uploaded the package to ProcurePortal at 13:04 PST. Upload record: PROC-FTI-9152. Link: https://procureportal.fintechco.com/upload/FTI-9152

Files included in the bundle (all are attached to this email thread):
- Redwood_SIG_20260308.pdf (completed & flattened SIG with cover letter)
- evidence_matrix_20260308.xlsx
- SOC2-letter-2025.pdf (signed, redacted for PII)
- architecture_diagram_v3.pdf (public version)
- kms_screenshot.png

Notes: GRC provided the SOC2 letter (see attached). I created a password-protected ZIP named FinTechCo_20260308_SIG.zip and uploaded that ZIP to the portal. Password was added to a HubSpot secure note under the FinTechCo opportunity (record FTI-2026-03-SIG) per our internal policy.

If Lena's team prefers individual files instead of a ZIP, we can re-upload — just let me know.

— Sergio
GRC Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_20260308.pdf; evidence_matrix_20260308.xlsx; SOC2-letter-2025.pdf; architecture_diagram_v3.pdf; kms_screenshot.png

Hi Marissa / Sergio —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the upload. We received the package in ProcurePortal (record PROC-FTI-9152). A couple of quick follow-ups from our security team after a preliminary pass:

1) Can you provide the PKI certificate or TLS configuration summary for egress endpoints used by your public API? A short (one-page) note is fine.
2) Please confirm your log retention policy for authentication & admin audit logs (how long retained, where, and how to request archived logs for audits).

We'll schedule a vendor review session for 2026-03-17 and will send calendar invites to marissa_cole@redwood.ai. If we need additional artifacts before then we'll reach out via this thread.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Best,
Lena Park
Procurement, FinTechCo
